pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Paste this sensor's pair code. In the LumeAir app, go to Settings › Home Assistant and tap Copy pair code next to the sensor.

data_description.pair_code: The pair code gives full access to the sensor. Home Assistant only reads it, on your home network.

user.title: Add a LumeAir sensor
user.description: Paste the sensor's pair code. In the LumeAir app, go to Settings › Home Assistant and tap Copy pair code next to the sensor.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts the pair code Home Assistant has, usually because it was set up again. Paste its current pair code from the LumeAir app.

error.invalid_code: That isn't a LumeAir pair code. Copy it again from the app.
error.wrong_sensor: That pair code is for a different sensor.
error.invalid_auth: The sensor didn't accept this pair code. Copy the current one from the app.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the sensor. Check that it's plugged in and on the same network as Home Assistant.

invalid_auth.message: The sensor no longer accepts its pair code.
